info.title: Secure Cloud Platform API
info.description:
Store files and encrypted secrets, with an API key.

- **Authentication:** send your key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
- **Versioning:** the version is in the URL (`/v1/...`). Within v1, changes are
  only ever additions; anything breaking would get a new version (`/v2/...`).
- **Rate limits:** per API key; see the `RateLimit-*` headers and `429` responses.
- **Errors:** every error is `{ "error": { "code", "message", "requestId" } }`
  with a stable `code`.

apiKey.description: An API key, e.g. `sk_live_3f9a0c1e7b2d4a68_...`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

post.description: Send the file as the raw request body (and optionally its name in X-File-Name). It is encrypted as it streams in, before it reaches the disk, and gets a new ID. The maximum size depends on the deployment (1 GiB by default), and counts against your storage limit.
